$comment: Declarative field-ordering rules for tools/lint_artifacts.py check_field_order (C-BET-03). The canonical narrative lives in models/common-fields.md §3.2. Ordered groups follow the object-category convention surfaced in _spec_review: identity/target, scope, subject/issuer, body, validity, issuance, audit. Hard precedence/immediacy rules below are wire-stable and enforced as errors (they already hold across all current schemas). The group-relative ordering checks were broadened in C-BET-03 to cover issued_at / not_before / effective_at / expires_at / revoked_* and role placement; some existing schemas serialize these in a different but still wire-valid order, so group rules are emitted as warnings rather than errors to avoid forcing a property reorder that would churn fixtures and the wire surface. See the report for the current deviation list.

ordered_groups.$comment: Within each named category group, when two member fields are both present on the same object they SHOULD appear in the listed order. Presence-conditional: missing members never trigger. Emitted as warnings.

role_after_subject.$comment: In subject/issuer grouped objects, a `role` discriminator SHOULD follow the principal/actor identity field it qualifies rather than precede it. Warning-only.
